question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'circumstances.'

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the words given in the options: 

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 instructions
 detailed information telling how something should be done, operated, or assembled. (निर्देश)
 
 

 circumstances
 the conditions and facts that are affecting a situation. (परिस्थितियाँ)
 
 

 questions
 a sentence or phrase used to find out information. (सवाल)
 
 

 lectures
 an educational talk to an audience, especially to students in a university or college. (व्याख्यान, भाषण देना)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• Let's look at the sentence: "A series of **__________*** in the world of trade, commerce, banking, and politics was responsible for it."
 
• We can say that the implied meaning of the sentence is that the **series of events and conditions** in the world of trade, commerce, banking, and politics led to the company's shutdown.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "circumstances" to make the sentence meaningfully correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

​

Complete passage:__ Little (1) over a year ago, Rama Rao went out of work when a gramophone company, of which he was the Malgudi agent, went out of existence. He had put into that agency the little money he had (2) inherited as security. For five years his business brought him (3) enough money, just enough to help him keep his wife and children in good comfort. And one day, it was (4) a bolt from the blue. A series of (5) circumstances in the world of trade, commerce, banking, and politics was responsible for it.
